newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian-built plane crashes kill 14 in October.
newsitem.headline: Russian-built plane crashes kill 14 in October.

text.p: Fourteen people were killed in crashes involving Russian-made aircraft in October compared with 26 people in the same month of last year, the CIS Interstate Aviation Committee (IAC) said on Tuesday.
An IAC statement said that four crashes and four other incidents were registered this October, compared with eight other incidents and four crashes in the same month of 1995.
The report also said 238 people died in 16 air crashes in Russian-made planes between January and October of this year compared with 86 deaths in 12 crashes in the same 1995 period.
Below are the main crashes involving Russian-made aircraft in October:

Oct 6 -- Antonov-12 cargo plane slid off a runway in Angola. Six people were killed due to cargo moving violently inside the aircraft. The plane destroyed a house near the runway and killed one person in it. After the crash local people burned the plane.
Oct 8 -- Antonov-124 cargo plane crashed near Turin airport, killing two people aboard and two local people.
Oct 12 -- A Mi-2 helicopter crashed in a lake in Siberia after its crew could not land it safely. The captain was killed.
Oct 26 -- A Yakovlev-40 passenger jet landed on a helicopter pad instead of the runway in the Siberian city of Khanty-Mansiisk. Five people were killed.
